name: WHOIS API
description: WHOIS API and DNS lookup API for Python and the command line: registrar, creation and expiry dates, status codes and nameservers of a list of domains, plus their A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS and other DNS records, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; one parsed format over RDAP and WHOIS, sign in with your QuanticData account.

commands.name: whois
commands.help: WHOIS registration data for one or more domains
commands.description: Registration data of each domain from its registry: registrar and its IANA id, creation, expiry and last-change dates, EPP status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. RDAP is used where the TLD offers it, the registry's WHOIS server otherwise.

inputs.name: domains
inputs.description: Bare domains or URLs, e.g. quanticdata.io.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many domains to deliver at most (1–25). Set it to the number of domains you send when that is more than 10. You pay only for delivered domains.

commands.name: dns
commands.help: DNS records of a domain (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS and more)
commands.description: DNS records of a domain, resolved over DNS over HTTPS, one row per record: type, TTL, data, MX and SRV priority and the host the record points to.

inputs.name: types
inputs.description: Record types to look up (default A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many records to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered records.
